walkthroughs.body_html: A symphony orchestra has around 80-100 musicians in four families: strings, woodwind, brass, percussion. A symphony is a long piece, usually in 4 movements.
Jazz began around 1900 in New Orleans, USA. African-American musicians combined blues, ragtime and band music. The saxophone, trumpet and piano became key.
Classical music is mostly written down note-for-note. Jazz centres on improvisation — making melodies up live over the chords.
